title: stocks and oil drop... ohh man
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: The no-new-regulation, self-policing AI accord is a 'nothing burger' that keeps the AI buildout (and bubble) inflating with no laws slowing it until at least 2029.
AI is at '10 p.m. in the party'; he sits at 8.7 on his bull/bear scale, so invest but pay off debt now ahead of an eventual bubble pop and recession.
With the 10-year near 5.25% (5.29% intraday) the pain feels like it is maxing out; Williams' dovish remarks signal the Fed wants to cap yields.
NY Fed's Williams suggesting the next hike can wait until December cut odds of two more hikes; expects PCE to meet expectations and hike odds to fall further.
Expects an Iran deal before markets do, which would be bullish; Hormuz flows recovering are pulling oil lower.
Bonds and real estate are near the bottom of their cycle ('6 p.m. at the party').

calls.condition: Upside tied to an Iran deal; he would favor December 18 options for that trade.
calls.reason: QQQ double-tested and held 735; no AI regulation, a dovish Fed and a coming Iran deal keep him bullish, though he sees AI late in the cycle with a bubble pop eventually.
calls.quote: Anyway, I maintain my bullish posture and I now have the balls to say it.

calls.condition: Renewed conflict with Iran could prove it wrong; expects TLT to hold or regain its 78.77 line.
calls.reason: Selling pain looks exhausted near 5.25% with 5.29% hit intraday; dovish Williams remarks show the Fed trying to cap yields; bonds near a cycle bottom.
calls.quote: I think we're getting to peak yields. Inverse trade me if you want.

notes: Long livestream (Trump AI summit, tax-strategy segment). Recorded Tuesday (Williams spoke 'Tuesday', PCE 'tomorrow', quarter ending this week), consistent with the Sep 29 listing; market commentary starts around the closing bell. TLT 78.77 level is in TLT dollars, not yield. Passing mentions without a call: NVDA bounce at 227, gold 4,200, Brent pulling back from 106-108, SpaceX, FICO, AVGO, PLTR, MRVL. He also mentions selling puts on an unnamed stock that benefits from an Iran deal and Kalshi bets (Iran deal before Mar 1; exactly one more Fed hike).
